	type_icon = "special_buildings/doges_palace.dds"
	
	can_construct_potential = {
        OR = {
            has_variable = DI_tm_building_edit_active
            AND = {
		building_requirement_tribal = no
	
            }
        }
    }
	
	is_enabled = {
        OR = {
            has_variable = DI_tm_building_edit_active
            AND = {
		scope:holder = {
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = government_is_not_republic_or_admin_desc
				OR = {
					government_has_flag = government_is_republic
					government_has_flag = government_is_administrative
				}
			}
		}
	
            }
        }
    }
	
	cost_gold = 1000
	
	county_modifier = {
		commerce_tax_mult = 0.2
		maritime_tax_mult = 0.2
		hostile_raid_time = 0.5
	}
	
	province_modifier = {
		garrison_size = 1
		fort_level = 3
		levy_size = 1
		defender_holding_advantage = 10
		travel_danger = -20
		province_size_baseline_add = 40
	}
	market_modifier = {
		trade_good_spices_sell_price_mult = special_building_need_sell_price
		trade_good_silk_sell_price_mult = special_building_need_sell_price
		trade_good_glass_sell_price_mult = special_building_need_sell_price
		trade_good_stone_sell_price_mult = special_building_need_sell_price
	}
	
	ai_value = {
		base = 10
		modifier = { # Fill all building slots before going for special buildings
			factor = 0
			free_building_slots > 0
		}
		ai_special_district_modifier = { LEVEL = 1 }
	}
	

	trade_good_need = {
		trade_good = trade_good_spices
		amount = special_building_need_amount
		can_be_filled_multiple_times = 5
		not_rite_parameter = luxury_forbidden

		modifiers = {
			county_modifier = {
				popular_opinion_add = special_building_need_popular_opinion
			}
		}
	}

	trade_good_need = {
		trade_good = trade_good_silk
		amount = special_building_need_amount
		can_be_filled_multiple_times = 5
		not_rite_parameter = luxury_forbidden

		modifiers = {
			province_modifier = {
				monthly_commerce_tax = special_building_need_tax
			}
		}
	}

	trade_good_need = {
		trade_good = trade_good_glass
		amount = special_building_need_amount
		can_be_filled_multiple_times = 5

		modifiers = {
			county_modifier = {
				prosperity_growth_factor = special_building_need_prosperity_medium
			}
		}
	}

	trade_good_need = {
		trade_good = trade_good_stone
		amount = special_building_need_amount
		can_be_filled_multiple_times = 5

		modifiers = {

the_tower_of_london_01 = {

	effect_desc = {
		triggered_desc = {
			trigger = { has_playable_adventurer_dlc_trigger = yes }
			desc = tower_of_london_pacification_effect
		}
	}

	construction_time = very_slow_construction_time

	type_icon = "special_buildings/tower_of_london.dds"
	
	asset = {
		type = pdxmesh
		name = "building_special_tower_of_london_mesh"
	}

	can_construct_potential = {
        OR = {
            has_variable = DI_tm_building_edit_active
            AND = {
		building_requirement_tribal = no
	
            }
        }
    }

	can_construct = {
        OR = {
            has_variable = DI_tm_building_edit_active
            AND = {
		scope:holder.culture = {
			has_innovation = innovation_battlements
		}
	
            }
        }
    }
	
	cost_gold = 1000

	on_complete = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { scope:character ?= { is_alive = yes } }
			}
			county.holder = { save_scope_as = character }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:character.culture ?= culture:norman
				has_global_variable = harrying_of_the_north
				exists = global_var:harrying_of_the_north.var:pacification
			}
			global_var:harrying_of_the_north = { save_scope_as = story }
			hidden_effect = {
				scope:character = {
					ep3_increase_pacification_large_effect = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}

	character_modifier = {
		dread_gain_mult = 0.3
	}
	max_garrison = good_building_max_garrison_tier_3
	province_modifier = {
		defender_holding_advantage = normal_building_advantage_tier_3
		fort_level = good_building_fort_level_tier_3
		stationed_maa_damage_mult = normal_maa_damage_tier_2
		stationed_maa_toughness_mult = normal_maa_toughness_tier_2
		stationed_siege_weapon_siege_value_mult = normal_maa_siege_value_tier_2
		travel_danger = -20
		province_size_baseline_add = special_building_province_size_baseline
		monthly_civic_tax = 0.5
	}
	market_modifier = {
		trade_good_stone_sell_price_mult = special_building_need_sell_price
		trade_good_wool_sell_price_mult = special_building_need_sell_price
	}
	
	ai_value = {
		base = 9
		culture_likely_to_fortify_modifier = yes
		modifier = {
			factor = 5
			scope:holder = {
				culture = {
					has_cultural_parameter = ai_more_likely_to_castle
				}
			}
		}
		modifier = { # Fill all building slots before going for special buildings
			factor = 0
			free_building_slots > 0
		}
		ai_special_district_modifier = { LEVEL = 1 }
	}
	

	trade_good_need = {
		trade_good = trade_good_stone
		amount = special_building_need_amount
		can_be_filled_multiple_times = 5

		modifiers = {
			province_modifier = {
				control_baseline_add = special_building_need_control
			}
		}
	}

	trade_good_need = {
		trade_good = trade_good_wool
		amount = special_building_need_amount
		can_be_filled_multiple_times = 5

		modifiers = {
			county_modifier = {

		}

			text = buddhas_of_bamian_trigger

			factor = 0
			free_building_slots > 0
		}

			desc = university_toto_effect_desc
		}

			trigger = { has_dlc_feature = royal_court }
			desc = university_roco_effect_desc
		}
		desc = university_effect_desc
	}

        OR = {
            has_variable = DI_tm_building_edit_active
            AND = {
		building_requirement_tribal = no
		building_university_requirement = yes
	
            }
        }
    }
	
	can_construct = {
        OR = {
            has_variable = DI_tm_building_edit_active
            AND = {
		scope:holder = {
			highest_held_title_tier >= tier_duchy
			prestige_level >= 4
		}
		county = {
			prosperity_level >= 30
		}
	
            }
        }
    }
	
	show_disabled = yes
	
	on_complete = {
		county.holder = {
			save_scope_as = founder

			found_university_decision_event_effect = yes

			every_player = {
				limit = {
					this != scope:founder
					is_within_diplo_range = { CHARACTER = scope:founder }
				}
				trigger_event = major_decisions.2002
			}
		}
	}
	
	cost_gold = 1000

	character_modifier = {
		learning_per_prestige_level = 1
		monthly_lifestyle_xp_gain_mult = 0.1
		cultural_head_fascination_mult = 0.05
		monthly_dynasty_prestige = 0.25
	}
	province_modifier = {
		province_size_baseline_add = special_building_province_size_baseline
	}
	
	ai_value = {
		base = 9
		modifier = { # Fill all building slots before going for special buildings
			factor = 0
			free_building_slots > 0
		}
		ai_special_district_modifier = { LEVEL = 1 }
	}

	character_culture_modifier = {
		parameter = roman_law_university_bonuses
		trade_competitiveness_mult = roman_law_university_competitiveness_value
	}

	province_culture_modifier = {
		parameter = roman_law_university_bonuses
		popular_opinion_add = roman_law_university_popular_opinion_value
	}
	market_modifier = {
		trade_category_books_sell_price_mult = special_building_need_sell_price
		trade_good_leather_sell_price_mult = special_building_need_sell_price
	}
	

	trade_good_need = {
		trade_good_category = trade_category_books
		amount = special_building_need_amount
		can_be_filled_multiple_times = 5

		modifiers = {
			county_modifier = {
				prosperity_growth_factor = special_building_need_prosperity
			}
		}
	}

	trade_good_need = {
		trade_good = trade_good_leather
		amount = special_building_need_amount
		can_be_filled_multiple_times = 5

		modifiers = {
			county_modifier = {
				prosperity_growth = special_building_need_prosperity
			}
		}

			factor = 0

		}

	}

mount_fuji_01 = {
	construction_time = very_slow_construction_time
	
	type_icon = "special_buildings/mount_apo.dds"

	asset = {
		type = pdxmesh
		name = "tgp_building_special_mt_fuji_mesh"
	}

	is_enabled = {
        OR = {
            has_variable = DI_tm_building_edit_active
            AND = {
		custom_description = {
			text = holy_site_shinto_or_holy_site_trigger
			OR = {
				scope:holder.religion = religion:shintoism_religion
				custom_description = {
					text = holy_site_building_trigger
					barony = { is_holy_site_of = scope:holder.faith }
				}
				scope:holder.faith = { has_doctrine = special_doctrine_immaterial_harmony }
			}
		}
	
            }
        }
    }
	
	show_disabled = yes
	
	cost_gold = 1000
	
	character_modifier = {
		monthly_piety = 0.25
		monthly_dynasty_prestige_mult = 0.05
		stress_loss_mult = 0.1
	}
	
	county_modifier = {
		religious_tax_mult = 0.15
		travel_danger = -30
	}
	

	market_modifier = {
		trade_good_incense_sell_price_mult = special_building_need_sell_price
	}
	trade_good_need = {
		trade_good = trade_good_incense
		amount = basic_resource_need

		modifiers = {
			character_modifier = {
				monthly_piety = 0.05
			}
		}
	}

	flag = travel_point_of_interest_religious
	flag = is_mountain
	flag = holy_building
}

		triggered_desc = {
			trigger = { has_dlc_feature = royal_court }
			desc = university_roco_effect_desc
		}
		desc = university_effect_desc
	}

	county_holder_character_modifier = {
		learning_per_prestige_level = 1
		monthly_lifestyle_xp_gain_mult = 0.1
		monthly_dynasty_prestige = 0.1
	}
	province_modifier = {
		province_size_baseline_add = special_building_province_size_baseline
	}
	
	ai_value = {
		base = 10
		modifier = { # Fill all building slots before going for special buildings
			factor = 0
			free_building_slots > 0
		}
		ai_special_district_modifier = { LEVEL = 1 }
	}

	character_culture_modifier = {
		parameter = roman_law_university_bonuses
		trade_competitiveness_mult = roman_law_university_competitiveness_value
	}

	province_culture_modifier = {
		parameter = roman_law_university_bonuses
		popular_opinion_add = roman_law_university_popular_opinion_value
	}
	market_modifier = {
		trade_category_books_sell_price_mult = special_building_need_sell_price
	}
	

	trade_good_need = {
		trade_good_category = trade_category_books
		amount = special_building_need_amount
		can_be_filled_multiple_times = 5

		modifiers = {
			county_modifier = {
				prosperity_growth_factor = special_building_need_prosperity_medium
			}
		}
	}

	flag = travel_point_of_interest_learning
	flag = special_university
}

tower_of_pisa = {
	construction_time = very_slow_construction_time

	type_icon = "special_buildings/tower_of_pisa.dds"

	asset = {
		type = entity
		name = "gdp_building_special_pisa_straight_entity"
	}

	can_construct_potential = {
        OR = {
            has_variable = DI_tm_building_edit_active
            AND = {
		building_requirement_tribal = no
	
            }
        }
    }

	cost_gold = 1000

	character_modifier = {
		monthly_prestige_gain_mult = 0.05
		monthly_dynasty_prestige_mult = 0.05
	}
	county_modifier = {
		popular_opinion_add = building_miniscule_popular_opinion_gain
	}
	province_modifier = {
		monthly_commerce_tax = 2
	}
	market_modifier = {
		trade_good_stone_sell_price_mult = special_building_need_sell_price
		trade_good_salt_sell_price_mult = special_building_need_sell_price
	}

	on_complete = {
		save_scope_as = tower_of_pisa_province
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:character ?= { is_ai = no }
			}
			set_variable = tower_of_pisa_to_inspect
			scope:character = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						cp:councillor_steward ?= { is_available_ai_adult = yes }
					}
					cp:councillor_steward = { save_scope_as = tower_of_pisa_messenger }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = {
						any_councillor = { is_available_ai_adult = yes }
					}
					random_councillor = {
						limit = { is_available_ai_adult = yes }
						save_scope_as = tower_of_pisa_messenger
					}
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = {
						any_courtier = { is_available_ai_adult = yes }
					}
					random_courtier = {
						limit = { is_available_ai_adult = yes }
						save_scope_as = tower_of_pisa_messenger
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = { exists = scope:tower_of_pisa_messenger }
					trigger_event = gdp_travel_events.2002
				}
				else = {
					trigger_event = gdp_travel_events.2003
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			county.holder = {
				trigger_event = {
					id = gdp_travel_events.2001
					days = 1
				}
			}
		}
	}

	ai_value = {
		base = 10
		ai_opinion_baseline_building_modifier = { VALUE = 5 }
		modifier = {
			factor = 0
			free_building_slots > 0
		}
		ai_popular_opinion_need_modifier = yes
		ai_special_district_modifier = { LEVEL = 1 }
	}

	trade_good_need = {
		trade_good = trade_good_stone
		amount = special_building_need_amount
		can_be_filled_multiple_times = 5

		modifiers = {
			province_modifier = {
				monthly_commerce_tax = special_building_need_tax
			}
		}
	}

	trade_good_need = {
		trade_good = trade_good_salt
		amount = special_building_need_amount
		can_be_filled_multiple_times = 5

		modifiers = {
			county_modifier = {
				prosperity_growth_factor = special_building_need_prosperity
			}
		}
	}

	flag = travel_point_of_interest_wonder
}
